'''Zhu Yongjun''' ({{zh|c=朱永𧸩|p=Zhū Yǒngjùn}}; 15 December 1929 – 8 June 2024) was a Chinese nuclear chemical specialist, and an academician of the [[Chinese Academy of Engineering]]. He was a member of the [[Chinese Nuclear Society]].

== Biography ==
Zhu was born in [[Jing County, Anhui|Jing County]], [[Anhui]], on 15 December 1929.<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.inet.tsinghua.edu.cn/szdw/lyys/zy_br_.htm |script-title=zh:朱永𧸩(中国工程院院士) 放射化学与放射化工专家 |work=tsinghua.edu.cn |date=20 April 2024 |access-date=11 June 2024 |language=zh}}</ref><ref name="ra">{{cite news |author1=Wang Hongze ({{lang|zh|王宏泽}}) |url=https://news.gmw.cn/2024-06/10/content_37371486.htm |script-title=zh:朱永𧸩院士逝世 |work=gmw.cn |date=10 June 2024 |access-date=11 June 2024 |language=zh}}</ref> In 1947, he entered [[Tsinghua University]], where he majored in the Department of Chemistry.<ref name="ra"/>

After graduation in 1951, Zhu stayed for teaching.<ref name="ra"/> He joined the [[Chinese Communist Party]] (CCP) in April 1955.<ref name="ra"/> He was promoted to associate professor in 1960 and to full professor in 1970.<ref name="ra"/> In 1979, he became deputy director of the Institute of Nuclear Energy Technology, and held that office until 1985.<ref name="ra"/>

On 8 June 2024, Zhu died in [[Beijing]], at the age of 94.<ref name="ra"/>

== Honours and awards ==
* 1993 State Natural Science Award (Third Class)<ref name="ab">{{cite news |author1=Yue Huairang ({{lang|zh|岳怀让}}) |url=https://www.thepaper.cn/newsDetail_forward_27681012?commTag=true |script-title=zh:核化学化工专家、中国工程院院士朱永𧸩逝世 |work=thepaper |date=9 June 2024 |access-date=11 June 2024 |language=zh}}</ref>
* 1995 Member of the [[Chinese Academy of Engineering]] (CAE)<ref name="ab"/>
* 1999 State Technological Invention Award (Second Class)<ref name="ab"/>
* 1999 Science and Technology Progress Award of the [[Ho Leung Ho Lee Foundation]]<ref name="ab"/>
